findings.title: Overlap cache proven below the S3 seam the Plan agreed; the observe and view wiring is untested
findings.detail:
The spec's Plan traceability row reads '| 60 overlap cached per pair of heads | S3 | integration | `overlap.json` |' (spec.md:336), and S3 lists 'the overlap cache' among what it observes (spec.md:265). The slice names Seams S1 and S3. AC3 ('Given neither story's head moved since the last tick, then the pair is not computed again') is proven only by packages/cli/test/unit/overlap-cache.test.ts, which calls storyOverlaps directly with a counting fake mergeTree and passes `prev` in by hand. These lines go untested: observe passing `local.overlap` (read from overlap.json) into storyOverlaps and writing the result back (index.ts:111-112), and the view feeding overlap.json into Facts so `norn status` shows the item (packages/view/src/load.ts:626). If observe passed [] instead of local.overlap, or the view dropped overlaps, every test would still pass while the behaviour broke. Sibling slices wrote their S3 rows as integration tests with createHarness (packages/cli/test/integration/push-rule.test.ts, base-side.test.ts). The handoff lists this as not proven yet.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a packages/cli/test/integration test with createHarness on real git: two stories in flight whose branches change the same file outside their spec folders. After a tick, `norn status --json` shows one overlap:<a>:<b> Check item naming both stories and the path. A second tick with neither head moved runs no merge-tree for the pair (for example, a pre-seeded overlap.json entry with a marker path is kept as is). Moving one head recomputes it. CI runs the integration tier. Locally `bun run test:integration <file>` checks that one file.

findings.title: Overlap item's `since` is the current tick, so its age resets every tick
findings.detail:
`since: iso(facts.now)` makes the item look new on every status render and every tick, so it sorts by age as the newest Check item for as long as the overlap lasts. StoryOverlap records no time it was first seen.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: keep a first-seen time in the cache entry for the pair of heads (or pair of stories) and use it as `since`.
